nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid making early army units that are not needed, as this could delay your tech and economy. Also, avoid expanding too early without proper defense.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue developing your economy and technology while keeping production moderate. Avoid overcommitting to a specific army composition until you have more information.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's build or when you reach a new phase of the game.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move towards a heavier defense and continue tech investment, preparing for the mid-game.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent's actions are not yet clear. They could be going for an early aggressive push or a macro-oriented build. Maintain awareness of potential early pressure.
nodes.own_situation: You are in the early game with a heavy economy and technology investment. Your production is moderate, and your army is not yet formed. You have a light defense and no clear expansion yet.
nodes.strategic_reason: A strong economy and tech lead will allow you to transition into a powerful mid-game army. Keeping production moderate conserves resources for tech and expansions.
nodes.title: Early Game Tech Focus
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a more defined army composition once you have scouted the opponent's intentions.
nodes.trigger_summary: At the start of the game, focus on establishing a solid economy and teching up. Production is moderate, and the army composition is not yet defined.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid neglecting scouting, as the opponent could be planning a surprise attack. Also, avoid over-expanding without proper army support.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to build up your economy and technology while increasing production. Start to invest in units that will form the core of your army, such as Marines and Siege Tanks.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have a clear picture of the opponent's army composition or when you are ready to move out.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move towards a heavy production and a defined ground army, with possible air support.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent may be starting to show their hand. They could be preparing for a push or expanding. Keep scouting to understand their composition.
nodes.own_situation: You are in the early-midgame with a heavy economy and technology. Your defense is now heavy, and production is increasing. Your army is still not fully formed, but you are leaning towards a ground-based force.
nodes.strategic_reason: A heavy defense protects your economy while you tech up. Increasing production allows you to build a larger army for the mid-game.
nodes.title: Mid-Game Transition
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a full ground-based army with Siege Tanks and Marines, and consider adding air support if needed.
nodes.trigger_summary: As the game progresses, you start to build a heavier defense and increase production. Your army is still undefined, but you are preparing for a ground-based composition.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being too passive, as the opponent could take advantage. Also, avoid neglecting anti-air defenses if the opponent goes for air units.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to build your ground army and expand. Consider adding air support, such as Banshees, to harass or defend against air threats.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have a significant army advantage or when the opponent makes a move.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move towards a late-midgame with a heavier expansion and a mix of ground and air units.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent may be preparing for a push or expanding themselves. They could have a variety of compositions, so keep scouting to adapt.
nodes.own_situation: You are in the mid-game with a heavy economy, production, and technology. Your army is ground-based with Siege Tanks, Marines, and Marauders. You have a heavy defense and are starting to expand.
nodes.strategic_reason: A strong ground army with Siege Tanks is powerful in TvT. Expanding gives you more resources to sustain a larger army and tech.
nodes.title: Heavy Production and Ground Army
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-midgame army with a mix of ground and air units, and continue expanding.
nodes.trigger_summary: You have reached the mid-game with a heavy economy and production. Your army is now ground-based with Siege Tanks, Marines, and Marauders. You are starting to expand.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid overextending without proper support, as the opponent could counter-attack. Also, avoid neglecting upgrades to keep your army strong.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to build your army and consider adding Thors for additional anti-air and anti-armor. Push out to take map control or attack the opponent's bases.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have a clear advantage or when the opponent's composition changes.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue to build your army and prepare for the late game, possibly adding more Thors or other units as needed.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent may be preparing for a final push or defending. They could have a variety of compositions, so keep scouting to adapt.
nodes.own_situation: You are in the late-midgame with a heavy economy, production, technology, and expansion. Your army is ground-based with Siege Tanks, Marines, Marauders, and Banshees. You have a heavy defense and are ready to take the initiative.
nodes.strategic_reason: A well-rounded army with Siege Tanks, Marines, Marauders, Banshees, and Thors is strong in TvT. Taking map control allows you to deny expansions and force engagements on your terms.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Army Composition
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-game army with a mix of units and upgrades, and aim to secure a decisive advantage.
nodes.trigger_summary: In the late-midgame, you have a heavy economy, production, and expansion. Your army is ground-based with Siege Tanks, Marines, Marauders, and Banshees. You are well-positioned for a strong push.

opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order. Adjust based on scouting information and opponent behavior.
opening.opening_summary: A macro-oriented Terran opening that prioritizes a strong economy and technology progression while keeping production moderate early on. The build transitions into a heavy ground-based army composition with Siege Tanks and Marines, supplemented by Banshees or Thors for air support. The approach is flexible, relying on live scouting to adapt to the opponent's actions.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a balanced macro posture while preserving flexibility for live observation-driven adaptation.
